messages:
Sophie (AE): Quick sync — ACME pilot: 6-week proof-of-value. Goals: align success criteria, timeline, and SE/eng coverage. Three primary use cases: 1) doc summarization 2) RAG for support KB 3) semantic search for catalog. Proposed milestones:

Week 0: onboarding + infra prep
Week 1-2: ingest + baseline evals
Week 3-4: tuning + model A/B
Week 5: stability + scale
Week 6: handoff + lessons

Deliverables I expect: config repo, eval harness + golden set, runbook, monitoring dashboard. What can SE/Eng commit to? Any enterprise blockers (security, capacity, licensing)?

Miguel (SE): I can own latency & throughput SLOs, monitoring dashboards and canary plan. A few clarifying Qs: what's avg doc length (tokens) and expected concurrent sessions? Also, if the KB contains PII we should flag for Private deployment now. We need ~2 weeks lead to reserve Dedicated nodes if they want predictable throughput.

Priya (Solutions): I can prepare prompt sets + eval harness. Recommend ~30 prompt examples per workload + golden answers. Proposed metrics: ROUGE for summarization, recall@10 for RAG, semantic-sim (cosine) target >=0.85 for search. Nightly eval runs + a weekly report. SE/AE need to provide sample docs and golden labels by day 5.

Anita (Eng): Eng support: ~4 hrs/week ongoing for platform config + a 8-12 hr ramp block during week 0-2 to get infra tuned. We can supply autoscale policy, prefix/KV caching config, and a standard rollback playbook. Note: Private deployment triggers a security review and license minimum. Need SOC2 + data-flow diagram for customer.

SecurityBot: SOC2 Type II report available (internal): https://redwood.internal/compliance/soc2.pdf — data-flow diagram template: https://redwood.internal/templates/data-flow.pptx

Jamal (Finance): For a 6-week hosted pilot we can offer $35k in credits up front (usage cap). If they insist on Dedicated, entry-level commit is $70k for the pilot window. Quick estimate: 50M tokens ~= $25k at current hosted rates; add 10% buffer. If Private requested, licensing minimum applies and contract lead time increases.

Sophie (AE): Can we confirm SE weekly hours and named owners? Also need a named contact for the security questionnaire; customer expects it completed by EOW. @Anita can you confirm who will fill questionnaire items?

Anita (Eng): I can take the questionnaire items with Priya — targeting EOD Friday for the initial pass. Also: to guarantee Dedicated capacity we need the commitment by day 10 of the engagement.

Miguel (SE): :thumbsup: I'll draft the runbook and create the monitoring dashboard. Using existing Redash templates for latency/cost. Quick dev commands for pilot env:
``
rdwctl env create pilot --region us-west-2
rdwctl deploy --env pilot --model redwood-llama-v1 --replicas 2
```

Priya (Solutions): I'll scaffold the eval harness and open a baseline PR with 3 sample prompts per workload by Wed.

Sophie (AE): Great — next steps: 1) SE/Eng confirm hours and owners (reply here) 2) Finance confirm trial credits (Jamal) 3) Security to deliver SOC2 + questionnaire answers by EOD Fri 4) Customer to provide sample docs and golden labels by day 5. I'll schedule a follow-up sync tomorrow 10am PT. @Miguel @Anita @Jamal @Priya please reply with availability. :calendar:

Miguel (SE): Available tomorrow 10am PT.

Priya (Solutions): Available. Will bring eval plan.

Anita (Eng): Can do 10am but may need to drop after 25 minutes.

Jamal (Finance): Confirmed. I'll post the formal credit offer in the thread after lunch.

Sophie (AE): Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll post the meeting invite and add the customer sample doc checklist.
